name: graphite
title: Graphite
description: Review, approve, comment on, and merge the pull requests in your Graphite inbox. Requires the Graphite and GitHub CLIs.
author: michalzuch

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Pull Request Inbox
commands.subtitle: Graphite
commands.description: See the pull requests in your Graphite inbox, then read, approve, comment on, and merge them.

preferences.name: defaultAction
preferences.title: Primary Action
preferences.description: Choose whether ↵ shows the pull request in Raycast or opens your preferred website. The other action moves to ⌘↵.

preferences.name: showReviewStatus
preferences.title: Show in List
preferences.label: Review status
preferences.description: Approved or changes requested, plus your own review.

preferences.name: showComments
preferences.label: Comments
preferences.description: Unresolved comments and approvals that came with comments.

preferences.name: showChecks
preferences.label: Checks
preferences.description: Whether CI checks pass, fail, or are still running.

preferences.name: showMergeStatus
preferences.label: Merge status
preferences.description: Ready to merge, merging, or merge conflicts, as reported by Graphite.

preferences.name: showUpdated
preferences.label: Last updated
preferences.description: When the pull request last changed.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Inbox Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Graphite
commands.description: Show your Graphite inbox in the menu bar, with a count of pull requests waiting on you.

preferences.name: showEmptySections
preferences.title: Menu Bar
preferences.label: Show empty sections
preferences.description: List sections that have no pull requests.

preferences.name: showCount
preferences.label: Show count next to the icon
preferences.description: Counts the pull requests in sections Graphite includes in your inbox total (marked ⚐).

tools.name: get-inbox
tools.title: Get Inbox
tools.description: List the pull requests in your Graphite PR inbox by section, with review status, unresolved comments, CI checks, and merge status.

tools.name: get-pull-request
tools.title: Get Pull Request
tools.description: Read a pull request in full: description, reviews, unresolved comments, checks, and Graphite's merge status.

tools.name: review-pull-request
tools.title: Review Pull Request
tools.description: Approve, request changes on, or comment on a pull request with the GitHub CLI, after you confirm.

tools.name: merge-pull-request
tools.title: Merge Pull Request
tools.description: Merge a pull request and the pull requests below it in its stack with Graphite, after you confirm. Only merges when Graphite says it's ready.

preferences.name: openPullRequestsIn
preferences.title: Open Pull Requests In
preferences.description: The website pull requests open in. The other one is always in the Actions panel.

preferences.name: celebrateMerges
preferences.title: Extras
preferences.label: Celebrate merges
preferences.description: Show confetti after you merge a pull request from Raycast.

preferences.name: repositoryFolders
preferences.title: Repository Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folders that hold your Git repositories, searched up to three levels deep. Used by Check out Locally (`gt get`).

preferences.name: gtPath
preferences.title: Graphite CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the `gt` executable. Leave empty to find it on your login shell's PATH.

preferences.name: ghPath
preferences.title: GitHub CLI Path
preferences.description: Path to the `gh` executable, used for reviews, comments, and checks. Leave empty to find it on your login shell's PATH.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
